clips.title: The story
paras: At the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City, Brother Sarno welcomes visitors and worshipers. The human cleric also directs Alliance travelers to Ironforge, where Tinkmaster Overspark needs help reclaiming Gnomeregan.

Inside the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, Brother Sarno greets pilgrims and travelers at the entrance. A brother of the Church of the Holy Light, he welcomes those who come seeking prayer, comfort, or guidance. His kind manner puts visitors at ease amid the cathedral’s daily life.

Brother Sarno also helps the Alliance beyond the cathedral. When word reached him that Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge needed help with his rogue invention, Techbot, in Gnomeregan, Sarno directed capable travelers toward Dun Morogh. His help supports the gnomes displaced from their home.
